long_biography.plain_text:
Acun Medya turned television formats into Acun Ilıcalı's international business. He established the company in 2004 after moving from on-screen work into entertainment production. It adapted global competition shows for Turkish audiences before developing original formats for markets in Europe and the Americas.

Control of distribution broadened the model. Acun Medya added national broadcaster TV8 in 2013, launched sports-and-entertainment channel TV8.5 and later introduced subscription platform Exxen. The group now combines programme production, channel ownership and digital delivery, with operations beyond Turkey. Ilıcalı remains closely identified with the programmes as a presenter as well as the founder behind the wider media group.
